scope: One targeted pass for independent evidence on AC1021→AC1024 VISUALSTYLE group-176/177 defaults, legacy fields and true-color fallback; existing production version gate is unchanged.

autodesk.finding: The native visual-style operation enum distinguishes inherit, set, disable and enable; inherit has numeric value 0.
The native integer setTrait overload defaults its operation to kSet. This is not evidence that DXF group 176 encodes the same enum or that a converted 2007 style must use kSet.
The entity entmod documentation describes precedence for group 420 over group 62; it does not establish VISUALSTYLE object groups 421/63 or 424/66 precedence.
The public VISUALSTYLE reference describes group 421 and edge-style-apply 174 but does not supply an AC1021-to-AC1024 mapping for group 176/177 or the dropped legacy fields.

ezdxf.result: PASS structural read and audit: AC1024, 16 VISUALSTYLE records, 0 audit errors and 0 audit fixes. It does not compare native property operations, rendered behavior or full document semantics.
ezdxf.implementation: Installed ezdxf entities/visualstyle.py SHA-256 445d5a19e95a19817ab531e7c373e8d6f2793ee82e43f0e6e9aead8684bf8090; its R2018 comments discuss group-176 delimiters, not an independently established 2007→2010 operation mapping.
ezdxf.palette: Its colors.py SHA-256 2dc20b764a7ca766f9719f954974e46348595669a4ae8eb7dd4da512e0ed16fb maps ACI 7 to white, 8 to RGB 128/128/128 and 9 to RGB 192/192/192. The peer target-2010 ColorChange frame pairs C2808080 with ACI 9; the existing AC1024 builder chooses 7. This discrepancy does not decide actual VISUALSTYLE fallback or native rendering.

acadsharp.finding: The inspected DWG reader marks VISUALSTYLE implementation incomplete, and the DXF reader explicitly skips 176 and 177. This checkout cannot independently validate those target field semantics.

decision: Keep the cross-version VISUALSTYLE gate closed. The LibreDWG observation of 176=0 and 177=2 is one implementation output; Autodesk operation defaults and entity color-precedence guidance do not establish that mapping, and an independent parser audit does not establish native semantics.
